scripts.test:restore: mkdir -p node_modules/.cache && esbuild scripts/run-restore-test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/restore-test.mjs --alias:@=./src && node node_modules/.cache/restore-test.mjs
scripts.test:perm: mkdir -p node_modules/.cache && esbuild scripts/run-permission-test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/permission-test.mjs --alias:@=./src && node node_modules/.cache/permission-test.mjs
